progression.narrative: The performance opens on C4 and dwells most on F in Forud. Chaharmezrab (1:35.1) introduces Bb, Dk, centred on C. The line peaks at F4 (365.9 Hz) at 0:49.8. It closes on the tonic (Dk4 → C4 → C4 → C4 → C4 → F4).
